chunks: Jaʿfar ibn Nājiyah narrated from him, peace be upon him, that he said:

If a man leaves Minā at the beginning of the night, then the night should not reach its midpoint except while he is in Minā. And if he leaves after the middle of the night, then there is no harm in his reaching the morning elsewhere.

key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.مِنًى: Minā, the sacred location where pilgrims stay during specific nights of hajj
key_terms.يَنْتَصِفْ: to reach the midpoint, referring here to midnight

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on leaving Minā during the night in hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding spending the nights of Minā during hajj. It indicates that one who departs at the beginning of the night must still be in Minā by midnight, whereas departure after midnight allows spending the remainder of the night elsewhere.
